name: Conditional Chat Reminder
description: Schedule a Teams reminder that sends only when the expected person has not already posted a relevant update.
author: Giorgio Ughini
coverImageAlt: Cyan update sphere holds a safety gate between an hourglass and a reminder chime.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: Show a one-shot reminder chime governed by a precise condition: a cyan update sphere arriving before an hourglass empties engages a mechanical safety gate that holds an orange clapper away from the chime, a metaphor for suppressing an unnecessary reminder when news arrives.
Scene/backdrop: compact slate clockwork chamber on a warm paper ground, with no interface elements
Subject: one elegant unmarked glass hourglass, one small suspended metal chime, one orange clapper held just short of contact, and one cyan glass update sphere visibly engaging the intervening gate; the conditional cause and effect should read instantly
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail, frosted glass, brushed metal, paper-cut supports, and restrained mechanical craft
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; compact centered mechanism with every element fully contained within the central 84% crop-safe area; simple strong silhouette and open margins
Lighting/mood: calm, considerate, precise, quietly technical; soft cyan safety glow and a restrained warm orange highlight
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, clock numerals, icons, chat bubbles, notification badges, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no product UI, chat UI, Teams branding, Microsoft branding, or Fluent gradients; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes
